title: Supply Chain and Contractor Learnings: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Seals were bought locally without a specification, and no one approved them technically.

sections.heading: How the part reached the job

events.text: Seals bought locally without a specification

items.lesson: A critical spare needs a specification before it is bought.
items.explanation: Purchase records show local buying without a specification [EVD-0003].

items.lesson: Someone must own the approval of a substitute.
items.explanation: The reliability engineer role named in the findings was absent [FND-0003].

items.change: Hold critical-spares orders until a specification is attached
items.indicator: % of critical spares with an approved specification
